title: Replace Airtable With a Custom AI Tool Built in an Afternoon
summary: Replace Airtable with a custom tool built in hours — no record limits, no per-seat fees. Build your own Airtable alternative with AI using Blink.
body_markdown: Most Airtable automations do one of three things: send an email, update a record, or call a webhook. All of those are describable in Blink. "When a record status changes to 'Approved', send an email to the assigned person with the record details" — Blink builds that. Complex multi-step automations with conditional logic take more iteration but are achievable without code.
